title: Human-in-the-Loop for Data Collection: a Multi-Target Counter Narrative Dataset to Fight Online Hate Speech
findings: The human-in-the-loop (HITL) data collection process showed an increasing imbalance in hate targets over iterative loops. Hate speech against Muslims became predominant in the generated dataset, while the proportion of hate speech against Jews diminished over the same loops.
